text: The City Clerk's Office has received notice that Efia Tekyi-Annan has resigned from the Confronting Anti-Black Racism Advisory Committee effective April 8, 2025. We would like to thank Efia for their contributions to the Committee. City staff will lead a process to bring a nominated candidate to City Council for their consideration to fill this vacancy.
The Confronting Anti-Black Racism Advisory Committee received the item for information.
